answer: A practical defence is Hallowed banquet manager licence with event caterers attestation. It rests on a licence caterers renew after banquet audits, which gives every honest agent a orchard that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a licence caterers renew after banquet audits — so privacy survives, and the delta is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. A farm doing the maths finds the timber first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one.
